partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Dual-arm positive-feedback GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: A drug can robustly break a GOF positive-feedback loop when it directly decreases both the upstream target and disease driver.
results.body: R200 plus direct binding and decreased activity/abundance of the GOF driver
results.mechanism_rationale: Two direct drug effects suppress both arms of a reciprocal activating loop around an explicit GOF driver.
results.trapi_notes: The dual target and loop paths are TRAPI-expressible; repeated drug identity, reciprocal endpoints, SIGNOR source, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[forward:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[back:REGULATES]->(target)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(driver)
MATCH (subject)-[driver_effect:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(forward.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(back.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND forward.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND back.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND forward.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND back.object_direction_qualifier = forward.object_direction_qualifier
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND driver_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND driver_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND driver_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Localized dual-arm positive-feedback GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: Dual-arm GOF feedback suppression is most credible when both loop genes share a compact process and affected anatomy.
results.body: R220 plus shared compact process and Bgee expression in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The drug suppresses both arms of the positive loop, and the complete module is localized by process and affected tissue.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; repeated drug identity, shared process/anatomy, Bgee provenance, source, and variant form require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[forward:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[back:REGULATES]->(target)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(driver)
MATCH (subject)-[driver_effect:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(forward.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(back.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND forward.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND back.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND forward.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND back.object_direction_qualifier = forward.object_direction_qualifier
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND driver_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND driver_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND driver_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND EXISTS {
  MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process:BiologicalProcess)
        <-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
  WHERE process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
}
  AND EXISTS {
  MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->
        (anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
        <-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]-(driver)
  MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
  WHERE 'infores:bgee' IN
        coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    AND 'infores:bgee' IN
        coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
}
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
